The immutable source constructs each ServiceState with a fresh uuid.uuid4() service_id (agent_observer/service_state.py:40), so service identity and original FactSupport values in each body are run-specific; cross-Python bodySha256 equality is not expected. Per-run wireDigestMatchesQueuedParts and the captured input/row/DTO/coverage summaries remain the supported checks. This does not establish full-frame byte parity or equality of unrecorded metadata.
